severity_thresholds.rule: Low: LST < μ−0.5σ · Moderate: μ−0.5σ ≤ LST < μ+0.5σ · High: μ+0.5σ ≤ LST < μ+1.5σ · Very High: LST ≥ μ+1.5σ

leakage_controls: LST excluded from inputs (it defines the labels)
spatial block hold-out instead of random split
imputer fitted inside each training pipeline only
thresholds are a fixed labelling rule, not learned parameters
